rules: anchor: for each E-KB4 target document, segment it with the publication's function (section-window-v1, window_chars), take chunk 0, and from its rune midpoint forward take the first window of 4 runes none of which is whitespace or punctuation (if none, the first such window from the start); the target is any chunk of the document
frequent: the 100 two-rune strings of CJK unified ideographs (U+4E00..U+9FFF) contained in the most chunks of the source corpus, ties by code points
absent: 4-rune strings drawn uniformly from U+4E00..U+9FFF with PCG(20261018, 11), keeping the first 50 that occur in no chunk of any listed corpus
